modeHint: The project's mode applies to files and chats and cannot be changed.
anonIntro: Every file is anonymised against the project's shared registry: the same value gets the same placeholder in every file and every chat. A file becomes visible to chats only once you confirm it after review.
anonIntroLocked: Every file is anonymised against the project's shared registry: the same value gets the same placeholder in every file and every chat. A file becomes visible to chats only once you confirm it after review. The chats have already sent messages: from here on, only additive changes are allowed.

drop.aria: Upload one or more files to the project
drop.idle: Drag project files here, or click to choose them
drop.busyHint: The transfer can take a few seconds: once done, the file joins the processing queue.
drop.hintAnon: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, LibreOffice, text, data or images (with OCR): it will be anonymised and put up for review.
drop.hintPlain: Any format: the file is stored exactly as it is.
drop.busyMore: You can already pick the others: they join the queue.

stale.title_one: One file is out of step with the current map
stale.title_other: {{count}} files are out of step with the current map
stale.body_one: Since it was redacted, the project registry has learned values it still holds in the clear: the same value ends up protected in one file and exposed in another. Re-redacting it brings everything back to the same placeholder.
stale.body_other: Since they were redacted, the project registry has learned values they still hold in the clear: the same value ends up protected in one file and exposed in another. Re-redacting them brings everything back to the same placeholder.
stale.bodyValues_one: Since it was redacted, the project registry has learned values it still holds in the clear ({{values}}): the same value ends up protected in one file and exposed in another. Re-redacting it brings everything back to the same placeholder.
stale.bodyValues_other: Since they were redacted, the project registry has learned values they still hold in the clear ({{values}}): the same value ends up protected in one file and exposed in another. Re-redacting them brings everything back to the same placeholder.
stale.badgeHint: The registry has learned values this file still holds in the clear
stale.badgeHintValues: The registry has learned values this file still holds in the clear: {{values}}
stale.aligned: File is in step with the current map

unchecked.label_one: One file was not checked (too large to check when the project opens):
unchecked.label_other: {{count}} files were not checked (too large to check when the project opens):

status.reviewHint: Review the anonymisation and confirm the file

chats.title: Project chats
chats.emptyAnon: No chats yet: create one — it will have access to every confirmed file in the project.
chats.emptyPlain: No chats yet: create one — it will have access to every file in the project.

toast.confirmed: File confirmed: the project's chats can now see it
toast.realigned: File realigned to the project's current registry

ocr.titleImage_one: This image is anonymised with OCR
ocr.titleImage_other: These {{count}} images are anonymised with OCR
ocr.bodyImage_one: The text will be read with OCR and sensitive information covered directly in the pixels. This takes a few seconds.
ocr.bodyImage_other: The text will be read with OCR and sensitive information covered directly in the pixels. This takes a few seconds.
ocr.bodyBatch: These files contain images. Do you want to use OCR to analyse them and cover the sensitive information found inside? The answer applies to the whole group.
ocr.batchImagesNote_one: The image is read with OCR anyway: without it there would be nothing to anonymise.
ocr.batchImagesNote_other: The {{count}} images are read with OCR anyway: without it there would be nothing to anonymise.
ocr.noText: This PDF has no selectable text (likely a scan): without OCR, anonymisation has nothing to work on.

confirmDeleteFile.title: Delete this file from the project?
confirmDeleteFile.text: “{{file}}” will no longer be visible to the project's chats. Placeholders already used in chats will keep resolving.

confirmRebuild.title_one: Re-redact the file against the current map?
confirmRebuild.title_other: Re-redact {{count}} files against the current map?
confirmRebuild.body_one: The file is reprocessed from the original with everything the registry has learned in the meantime: values left in the clear take the same placeholder they already have in the other files.
confirmRebuild.body_other: The files are reprocessed from the originals with everything the registry has learned in the meantime: values left in the clear take the same placeholder they already have in the other files.
confirmRebuild.confirmed_one: One file is already confirmed: in past turns the model may have read its values in the clear. From now on it will see them protected — what has already been sent is not rewritten, and placeholders keep resolving.
confirmRebuild.confirmed_other: {{count}} files are already confirmed: in past turns the model may have read their values in the clear. From now on it will see them protected — what has already been sent is not rewritten, and placeholders keep resolving.
confirmRebuild.queued: The reprocessing is queued: follow it from the jobs bar.

catsDialog.title: Categories to anonymise
catsDialog.description: These apply to the next files uploaded and to the next messages in every chat of the project. Whatever has already been sent stays as it is.
